texts.en:
Reports have started coming in from Spymaster [from.leader.GetName], assigned to the [from.target.GetName]. This marks the beginning of our first Spy Network within a foreign empire.

Though we may look alike on the surface, we shall soon discover just how these particular [from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural] might differ from ourselves...

texts.zh: 我们开始在[from.target.GetName]进行隐秘活动。间谍首脑[from.leader.GetName]现在开始全权负责[from.target.GetAdj]中快速发展的间谍网。
texts.en: Our presence in the [from.target.GetName] has taken on a clandestine aspect. Spymaster [from.leader.GetName] is now situated at the core of a burgeoning Spy Network in [from.target.GetAdj] space.

texts.zh: 我们开始在[from.target.GetName]进行隐秘活动：间谍首脑[from.leader.GetName]已经开始执行谍报章程。我们新建立的间谍网让我们可以观察[from.target.GetAdj]的活动，并在必要的时候渗透并介入。
texts.en: Our presence in the [from.target.GetName] has taken on a clandestine aspect: Spymaster [from.leader.GetName] has engaged Espionage protocols. Our newly-established Spy Network will allow us to observe [from.target.GetAdj] activities, infiltrating and intervening where necessary.

texts.zh: 我们收到了间谍首脑[from.leader.GetName]从[from.target.GetName]发回的第一份密报，标志着我们在外星帝国的第一个间谍网的基本成型，这将有效提醒我们提防那些外星杂碎们的阴谋诡计。
texts.en: We have received our first clandestine report from Spymaster [from.leader.GetName], inside the [from.target.GetName]. This marks the foundation of our first Spy Network within a xeno empire - ideally positioned to warn us of their alien and duplicitous schemes.

texts.en: We have received our first clandestine report from Spymaster [from.leader.GetName], inside the [from.target.GetName]. This heralds the foundation of our first Spy Network within a xeno empire. From this day forward, they too will realize the formative benefits of [owner.species.GetAdj]-honed information control...

texts.en: We have received our first clandestine report from Spymaster [from.leader.GetName], inside the [from.target.GetName]. This marks the establishment of our first Spy Network within xeno territory. Whenever they make a move, we stand a better chance of it playing right into our [owner.species.GetHandNamePlural].

summary.text:
# 间谍网已建立 / Spy Network Established

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13
- 来源 Sources：`events/nemesis_espionage_events.txt:12-160`

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 隐藏事件 espionage.1 在 on_spynetwork_formed 时触发：非AI、目标为普通帝国，且该国此前没有 first_spynetwork 标志；之后设置该标志（每个帝国一次）。
  Hidden event espionage.1 fires on on_spynetwork_formed: non-AI empire, target a normal empire, no first_spynetwork flag yet; the flag is then set (once per empire).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 5天后出现六个窗口之一（if/else-if 链）：同族目标 18；蜂巢帝国 10；机器帝国 11；排外 16；威权 17；其余 15。每个只有一个确认选项。
  Five days later one of six windows appears (if/else-if chain): same species 18; hive 10; machine 11; xenophobe 16; authoritarian 17; everything else 15. Each has a single acknowledgement option.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 六个窗口互斥，故事到此结束。
  The six windows are exclusive and the story ends there.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 窗口按帝国类型而异。
  The window varies by empire type.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：espionage.1 的链顺序与各窗口触发。
  Checked: the chain order of espionage.1 and each window's trigger.
